prompt: How many versions of the .NET platform have been released that have a support lifetime of more than 12 months?
answer: 12 versions. All listed .NET/.NET Core versions had support lasting more than 12 months except .NET Core 3.0, which was supported from September 23, 2019, to March 3, 2020.
